question.prompt: Find the additive inverses of \(-7\) and \(3/4\), and simplify \(-(-5)\). (Give the answers in order, separated by commas.)

solutions.explanation: Two numbers that differ only in sign are additive inverses: the additive inverse of \(-7\) is \(7\), and the additive inverse of \(3/4\) is \(-3/4\). \(-(-5)\) is the additive inverse of \(-5\), which equals \(5\).
solutions.title: Apply the additive-inverse definition
